meta_description: Glazed multi-colour Moroccan-style mosaic tiles for kitchen backsplashes and feature walls. See them in Lahore or Islamabad or get a free WhatsApp sample.
description:
Our Moroccan mosaic tiles for kitchen walls are glazed ceramic mosaic pieces in several colours, laid in a Moroccan-inspired geometric pattern for backsplashes and feature walls.

## How they look
Moroccan-style patterns use repeating geometric shapes and bold colour, so a small area makes a strong statement. The glazed surface gives the colours depth and shine. This is a Moroccan-style design sold by Pak Clay, not a tile imported from Morocco.

## Where they work
- **Kitchen backsplashes** behind the counter or sink.
- **A single feature wall** in an open kitchen or dining area, with plain walls around it.
- **Café counters and restaurant walls** that want a lively, patterned surface.

Because the pattern is busy, it usually looks best with plain cabinets and a simple counter top. A second Moroccan design is also listed: see [Moroccan mosaic kitchen wall tiles 002](/products/glazed-multi-colours-moroccan-mosaic-kitchen-wall-tiles-002).

## Good to know
Order a little extra so the pattern can be matched at corners and cut edges. Glazed ceramic is generally easy to wipe clean, which helps on a cooking wall.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colours in your light, then get a dated quote. Browse the [kitchen wall mosaic range](/categories/mosaic-kitchen-wall-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of Moroccan mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are these tiles imported from Morocco?
faqs.a: No claim of Moroccan origin is made. They are Moroccan-style glazed ceramic mosaics sold by Pak Clay in Pakistan. Ask on WhatsApp for any details you need about the product.

faqs.q: Moroccan mosaic or plain subway tiles for a kitchen?
faqs.a: Moroccan mosaic makes the backsplash the main feature, so it suits kitchens with plain cabinets. Subway tiles are calmer and easier to match with patterned floors or busy counter tops.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message +92 300 4617715 on WhatsApp with the product name and city, or visit the Lahore or Islamabad showroom.
